items.title: Fed comments and General Mills, Cracker Barrel earnings: What to Watch
items.summary: Asking for a Trend Host Josh Lipton takes a closer look at the top stories for investors to watch on Wednesday, Sept. 23, including earnings calls from General Mills (GIS) and Cracker Barrel (CBRL), and Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr speaking about the economic outlook and housing.

items.title: General Mills Q1 fiscal 2027 earnings beat estimates, stock falls
items.summary: The cereal and snacks maker topped sales and profit estimates but reaffirmed a cautious full-year outlook as higher input costs squeezed margins

items.title: General Mills Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates on Pricing and Mix Benefits
items.summary: GIS tops first-quarter estimates as pricing and mix offset higher input costs and lower volume, while sales and earnings fall year over year.

items.title: General Mills Confronts the AI Grocery Era
items.summary: Food companies are girding for AI to take over grocery shopping. “We know just in this last month alone that 40% of consumers used an AI tool to make a purchase in food,” General Mills Chief Operating Officer Dana McNabb said on Wednesday.

items.title: Pre-Markets Take a Breather from AI-Trade Resurgence
items.summary: A Fed governor speech today may give the market insights on future FOMC moves.

items.title: Hormel Foods vs General Mills: One Dividend Rests on Solid Cash, the Other on Fumes
items.summary: Both Hormel and General Mills paid out more in dividends than they earned last year, but that shared screener flag tells a completely different story at each company. One dividend sits on solid footing while the other is quietly running out of room.

items.title: General Mills Beats Earnings Estimates in ‘Volatile Environment.’ The Stock Is Falling.
items.summary: General Mills stock falls as consumer concerns outweigh the company’s better-than-expected earnings.
